en.title: Bullock & Kidman Conjure Magic at 'Practical Magic' Screening
en.summary: Sandra Bullock and Nicole Kidman surprised fans with an appearance at a special screening of their beloved 1998 film 'Practical Magic.' The iconic duo took the stage at the historic Hollywood Forever Cemetery, adding an extra layer of enchantment to the Cinespia outdoor film event.
en.body:
Hollywood Forever Cemetery transformed into a haven of sisterhood and spellbinding cinema this past Saturday, August 1, 2026, as **Sandra Bullock** and **Nicole Kidman** made a surprise appearance at a screening of their cult classic, **'Practical Magic.'** Fans gathered for the Cinespia outdoor film series, ready for midnight margaritas and a dose of nostalgic magic, but few anticipated the arrival of the Owens sisters themselves. Dressed to impress, the acclaimed actresses took to the stage to introduce the 1998 film that has charmed audiences for decades, igniting a wave of excitement among the assembled cinephiles.

This magical night served as a potent reminder of the film's enduring legacy and the unique chemistry between Bullock and Kidman. Their appearance comes at a particularly exciting time, with a sequel to **'Practical Magic'** officially teased at CinemaCon 2026. The prospect of seeing the beloved witches return has fans buzzing, and this surprise reunion only amplifies the anticipation. The actresses themselves have hinted at what fans can expect from a potential follow-up. "We can expect 'midnight margaritas, jumping off the roof and also have our past catching up with us,'" **Nicole Kidman** shared at CinemaCon, while **Sandra Bullock** described returning for the sequel as "like we came back to a home that we once lived in." This sentiment perfectly captures the feeling many fans have for the original film – a comforting, magical escape.

## A Spellbinding Reunion

The presence of **Bullock** and **Kidman** at the Hollywood Forever screening was more than just a celebrity cameo; it was a heartfelt nod to the dedicated fanbase that has kept **'Practical Magic'** alive and thriving through the years. Cinespia, known for its unique outdoor cinematic experiences, provides the perfect backdrop for such an event, blending the ethereal atmosphere of the cemetery with the communal joy of watching a beloved film under the stars. For those who grew up with the Owens sisters or discovered their story more recently, seeing **Bullock** and **Kidman** together, celebrating the film that launched a thousand midnight margaritas, was a truly special moment. It underscores how deeply the film has resonated, becoming a touchstone for themes of family, destiny, and the enduring power of love and sisterhood.

## What's Next for the Owens Sisters

With the sequel officially in the works, the surprise appearance at the **'Practical Magic'** screening feels like a potent omen. Fans are eagerly awaiting more details about the next chapter for Sally and Gillian Owens. While specific plot points and a release date have not yet been announced, the excitement generated by this event, coupled with the earlier CinemaCon teases, suggests that the magic of **'Practical Magic'** is far from over. The film series, now celebrating its 25th anniversary with Cinespia, continues to cast its spell, proving that some cinematic enchantments are truly timeless.
